elasticsearch-8.15.3: Elasticsearch 8.15.3, self-hosted in Docker on the benchmark host.
Single node, one primary shard, zero replicas, 1 GiB fixed JVM heap.
Text uses the standard tokenizer, lowercase filter, and Elasticsearch's English stop-word list to approximate Antfly's fixed Bleve analyzer.
Timed TOP_K requests disable _source, stored fields, and exact total-hit counting.
The completed index is refreshed and force-merged to one segment before queries.
weaviate-1.38.2: Weaviate 1.38.2, self-hosted as a single Docker node on the benchmark host.
The collection disables vectorization and indexes one text property for native BM25F.
Word tokenization and the English stop-word preset approximate Antfly's fixed analyzer.
Term, OR, and AND queries are timed; the BM25 surface has no exact phrase-query operator.
postgresql-16: PostgreSQL 16 from the self-hosted pgvector image; pgvector is not involved in lexical execution.
Documents use a stored English tsvector with a GIN index and rank with ts_rank_cd.
The adapter translates term, OR, AND, and phrase classes to native tsquery expressions.
Timed queries return document IDs only over one persistent PostgreSQL connection per worker.
milvus-2.5.8: Milvus 2.5.8 is retained visibly but is not timed on this unchanged corpus.
Milvus BM25 requires raw text in a VARCHAR input field with a 65,535-byte maximum.
Twenty documents in the 250k corpus exceed that limit; the maximum is 202,798 bytes.
Truncating only Milvus would change the benchmark workload, so every query class is marked unsupported.
chroma-self-hosted: Chroma is retained visibly as a target competitor but is not timed in this full-text lane.
The self-hosted document text surface offers case-sensitive contains/regex filtering, not ranked lexical top-k retrieval.
Chroma's richer Search API is cloud-only and is excluded by the self-hosted-only benchmark policy.
